summary_requirements: Mid-market SaaS product team building an in-product agent for B2B users. Primary workload: multi-step agent flows that search internal docs, call external tools (account actions, calendar, ticket updates), and stream partial responses. Targets: 99th percentile end-to-end latency <= 800ms for short-turn interactions, streaming tails under 2s, throughput 100-300 concurrent agents during peak. Cost-sensitive but willing to commit to Dedicated if unit economics clear.
notes:
— Intro call 2026-02-18 (Jordan/Priya) w/ CTO Marta Lopez + Product lead Ethan Kim. High-level interest in hosted API first, then Dedicated for predictable throughput.
— Use-case: agentic workflows inside product: search + action (ticket creation, status updates, calendar suggests). Multi-step tool chains expected; example flow discussed: find customer record -> open ticket -> propose escalation steps -> call internal ticket API.
— POC ask: prove streaming reliability + tool-call retries and visibility. Specifically asked: how long before tool-call timeout vs model continuation; can calls be retried transparently; how do fallbacks surface to user.
— Latency SLOs: team emphasized 99p tail more than average; "streaming must feel realtime for short tasks". They want token-level telemetry in console and route-level breakdowns.
— Security: SSO/SAML required for admin, audit logs, KMS for keying, and option for VPC/private plane for Dedicated later. Data residency: US only for now.
— Pricing: strong sensitivity; ask for a Dedicated reservation example for 3x 3090-equivalent with burst to handle 2x peaks. Jordan to draft pricing scenarios; request for a side-by-side cost/perf sim using their query mix.
— Demo 2026-03-05: live stream + function/tool-calling demo. Observed one tool-call timeout during demo (FF id ff_20260305_demo_007) — flagged by product as primary risk.
— Internal stakeholders: Marta Lopez (CTO) decision maker; Ethan Kim (Head of Product) technical champion; Lynne Ortiz (Finance) evaluating ARR/commitment; security reviewer Rajesh Mehta queued.
— Current sentiment: interested but cautious. Quote from Ethan: "If tool calls occasionally fail and the agent halts, our users will lose trust — need transparent retries and graceful fallback UI."
— POC plan: 2-week sandbox using hosted API with sampling of real queries + synthetic high-concurrency test (week 1 telemetry, week 2 scale + error-injection). Post-POC decision to either move to Dedicated pilot or continue hosted with optimizations.
— Next immediate actions: Jordan to send POC checklist + telemetry template; Priya to scope canary config and batching suggestions; AE to provide Dedicated pricing scenarios by 2026-03-12.
— Blockers: pending SSO SAML test credentials, finance sign-off on ARR range, and clear SLA for tool-call behavior.
— Related artifacts: pricing deck (drive link above), security FAQ draft, and Jira ticket INF-3421 for demo-timeout investigation.
